metadata.title: Masroof Financial Transaction Engine - Comprehensive Test Suite
metadata.author: Test Cases Designer Subagent
metadata.description: Extensive, rigorous, and adversarial test suite covering all 10 major Jordanian financial institutions and mobile wallets, multi-currency support (JOD, USD, SAR, AED, EUR), varied decimal notations, and hard negative traps (conversational chat noise, personal phone number senders, 3DS purchase authorization OTPs, login OTPs, declined transactions, system announcements, and marketing campaigns).
